newsitem.title: LATVIA: Volume surges on Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Volume surges on Latvian bourse.

text.p: Volume surged on Latvia's infant bourse on Thursday, the Riga Stock Exchange said in a statement.
Overall market volume leapt to over 165,000 lats compared with just 26,500 lats on Tuesday.
Turnover on the central market was close to 91,000 lats while block trades accounted for almost 78,000 lats of market volume.
Market leader Unibanka regained the ground it lost Tuesday with its share price bouncing back to 1.75 lats from 1.70 lats, a 2.94 percent increase. Over 82,000 lats worth of its shares changed hands.

The Riga Transport Fleet also posted an impressive gain, with its share price jumping 11.11 percent from 0.63 lats to 0.70 lats after rising by 8.62 percent on Tuesday. The volume of its shares traded was just over 5,800 lats.
On the market's secondary list, the Fish Cannery Kaija saw its price rise by 9.38 percent from 0.32 lats to 0.35 lats and its turnover was 2,275 lats.
